canonical_scope.people: Australian employees in ANZSCO 5311 General Clerks roles at participating workplaces
canonical_scope.standard: no involuntary loss of real hourly earnings or essential employment conditions attributable to the transition

mappings.rationale: The canonical scope preserves the agency-map outcome scope without rewriting its native hash domain.
The possible path names the same people, employment destination, standard, place and period in its own native contract.
unresolved_differences: The agency map uses reach while the possible path uses transition as its verb.
The possible path condition identities do not match the agency-map condition identities.
The possible path has no native structured jurisdiction, geography, service or timestamp fields.
